title: AIMProfiles
description: AI Module Profile (MPAI-PRF V1.0, JSON Syntax and Semantics): the Attributes, and Sub-Attributes, that an AIM instance signals, as ALL (the listed Attributes are not supported) or NUL (the listed Attributes are supported) followed by +/- Attributes, @EPS#<Sub-Attributes> and @TRN#<language><->|-><language>.
